title: The 9am standup — Nadia, 47, and the word nobody said (menopause at work)
caption:
Hot flashes at work aren't a phase — median 7.4 years (SWAN, JAMA Intern Med 2015).
Bring a Menopause Rating Scale score to your appointment.
Send this to her — told her boss, or stayed quiet?
www.aiforheratx.org
#menopause #perimenopause #womenshealth #menopauseatwork #midlifewomen

scenes.text: She lost the word *quarterly* mid-sentence and blamed the coffee.
phrases: She peeled the cardigan off. Again.
Blamed the coffee. Then blamed herself.
Nobody in that room said the word menopause.

scenes.text: Hot flashes and night sweats last a median of *7.4 years* — not a few months.
She scored her 11 symptoms in five minutes and put the page on her doctor's desk.
phrases: Eleven symptoms. Five minutes. One page.
She wrote what each one did to her workday.
Her doctor read it and finally had something to work with.

scenes.text: Score your 11 symptoms tonight, then put 150 minutes of movement into this week.
phrases: Fill the Menopause Rating Scale tonight — it takes 5 minutes.
Next to each one, write what it costs you at work.
Book 150 min of moderate movement this week, plus 2 strength sessions (WHO).
Take the page to your appointment instead of trying to remember it.
